interface.shortDescription: Build and configure Soofi products with guided workflows.
interface.longDescription: Product builders and configurers with guided feature increments for Documentation, Account, Console, Environment, Build, Deploy, Model, Marketplace, Transform, Persist, Rule, Connect and System.
defaultPrompt: Use Unown to build Documentation with React, TypeScript and tRPC.
Use Togetic to publish and test documentation on an existing deployment.
Use Chandelure to build or fix Console.
Use Vivillon to configure and test a Console application.
Use Conkeldurr to build or fix Persist.
Use Zygarde to build System through guided mock scenarios.
Use Celebi to configure a System outcome.
